subsystems.name: Active molecule design
subsystems.role: select or synthesize small molecules that inhibit histone deacetylases (HDACs) to alter gene expression linked to skin aging.
parts: HDAC inhibitor compounds (e.g., hydroxamic acids, short-chain fatty acids)

subsystems.name: Delivery system
subsystems.role: carry the actives past the skin barrier and into the target layers (epidermis, dermis).

subsystems.name: Formulation base
subsystems.role: provide a stable, spreadable, and pleasant vehicle for the actives.

subsystems.name: Testing and validation
subsystems.role: measure epigenetic changes and anti-aging effects in vitro and in vivo.

subsystems.name: Manufacturing and quality control
subsystems.role: produce consistent, safe, and effective products at scale.

buildSteps.title: Identify epigenetic targets
buildSteps.detail: Study how histone acetylation changes with skin aging and pinpoint which HDAC enzymes are most relevant to wrinkles, thinning, and loss of elasticity.

buildSteps.title: Screen or design inhibitors
buildSteps.detail: Test libraries of natural or synthetic small molecules for HDAC inhibition, selectivity, and safety on skin cells.

buildSteps.title: Test in skin models
buildSteps.detail: Apply candidate molecules to cultured skin cells or reconstructed epidermis and measure changes in gene expression and aging-related proteins.

buildSteps.title: Develop a stable formulation
buildSteps.detail: Incorporate the active into a cream or serum base, optimizing pH, preservatives, and shelf life while maintaining activity.

buildSteps.title: Optimize skin penetration
buildSteps.detail: Use encapsulation or penetration enhancers and measure how much active reaches the target skin layers with diffusion cells.

buildSteps.title: Assess safety
buildSteps.detail: Run irritation and sensitization tests in vitro, followed by human patch tests to rule out adverse reactions.

buildSteps.title: Conduct clinical trials
buildSteps.detail: Carry out randomized controlled trials measuring wrinkle depth, elasticity, and other aging markers over weeks to months.

buildSteps.title: Scale up and substantiate claims
buildSteps.detail: Manufacture at commercial scale and compile evidence to support any anti-aging claims under cosmetic regulations.

prerequisites.tech: Understanding of epigenetic regulation in skin aging
prerequisites.why: the link between histone acetylation and specific aging signs is still being mapped.

prerequisites.tech: Safe and effective HDAC inhibitors for topical use
prerequisites.why: many inhibitors are unstable, irritating, or lack selectivity for skin targets.
liposomes, nanoparticles, and chemical enhancers are already used in cosmetics and pharmaceuticals.

prerequisites.tech: Clinical trial methods for skin aging
prerequisites.why: standardized grading and instrumental measurements are well established for cosmetic claims.
cosmetics do not require pre-market approval in many regions, but claims must be substantiated.

pathway.milestone: basic research on HDAC inhibitors in skin cell and tissue models
pathway.unlocks: identification of promising molecules and mechanisms.

pathway.milestone: optimized formulations with proven penetration and stability
pathway.unlocks: reliable delivery of actives to target skin layers.

pathway.milestone: clinical trials demonstrating measurable anti-aging effects
pathway.unlocks: scientific substantiation for epigenetic skincare claims.

pathway.milestone: commercial products with validated epigenetic benefits
pathway.unlocks: a new class of evidence-based anti-aging topicals.
